paper.title_en: Investigating the Viability of Dedicated Microhertz Gravitational Wave Pulsar Timing
paper.abstract_en: The microhertz gravitational wave (GW) frequency regime remains one of the least explored regions of the GW spectrum. This is due to the physical limitations of our current and upcoming GW observatories such as LIGO and LISA, which are tuned to dHz and mHz respectively. Proposed experiments targeting the $μ$Hz regime are ambitious, expensive and unlikely to be operational within the next 20 years. Pulsar Timing Arrays (PTAs), with their Galaxy-sized baselines, occupy the other end of the spectrum; the frequencies they are sensitive to are a function of the observing cadence and total dataset timespan. Existing PTA campaigns have cadences and timespans corresponding to the nanohertz regime, however the possibility exists that they can be 'pushed' to detect higher frequencies. This paper investigates the viability of a custom microhertz-sensitive PTA, observing a small number of millisecond pulsars with a daily cadence, over the course of 1 and 2 years respectively. We assume the use of both 100-m and 500-m class radio telescopes for these observations, and an idealised noise model with negligible systematics to determine the most optimistic detection threshold. We compute the sensitivity of our proposed high-cadence PTA configurations to power-law signals and individual GW sources. We find that a 500-m class telescope would likely be able to set new upper limits on individual sources and GW background signals in the $0.1-1~μ$Hz range; while a 100-m class telescope would, in the best case, only match that of the performance of the EPTA second data release in the same range. Finally we consider a possible $μ$Hz PTA consisting of SKA-Mid and DSA observing 24 pulsars; we find this performs on par with the 500-m class while using far less telescope time, presenting a more feasible solution to microhertz-GW pulsar timing.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究定制化微赫兹脉冲星计时阵列的可行性，系统计算高节奏观测对功率律信号和单个引力波源的灵敏度，并比较100米、500米级射电望远镜以及SKA-Mid与DSA组合方案。主题明确属于PTA范畴，方法框架清晰，对μHz频段探测阈值有潜在参考价值；因论文仅2天且零引用，按规则社区信号不作扣分。
decision.title_zh: 探究专用微赫兹引力波脉冲星计时的可行性
decision.abstract_zh: 微赫兹（μHz）引力波（GW）频段仍然是引力波频谱中探索最少的区域之一。这是由于我们当前和即将建成的引力波天文台（如分别调谐至dHz和mHz的LIGO和LISA）的物理限制。针对μHz频段提出的实验雄心勃勃、成本高昂，且不太可能在未来20年内投入运行。脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）凭借其银河系尺度的基线，占据了频谱的另一端；它们所能敏感的频率是观测节奏和总数据集时间跨度的函数。现有的PTA观测项目的节奏和时间跨度对应于纳赫兹频段，然而它们有可能被“推高”以探测更高频率。本文研究了定制微赫兹敏感PTA的可行性，即在1年和2年期间分别以每日节奏观测少量毫秒脉冲星。我们假设使用100米级和500米级射电望远镜进行这些观测，并采用系统误差可忽略的理想化噪声模型，以确定最乐观的探测阈值。我们计算了所提出的高节奏PTA配置对功率律信号和单个引力波源的灵敏度。我们发现，500米级望远镜很可能能够在$0.1-1~μ$Hz范围内对单个源和引力波背景信号设定新的上限；而100米级望远镜在最佳情况下仅能在同一范围内达到EPTA第二数据发布（second data release）的性能水平。最后，我们考虑了一个由SKA-Mid和DSA观测24颗脉冲星组成的可能μHz PTA；我们发现其性能与500米级望远镜相当，但使用的望远镜时间要少得多，为微赫兹引力波脉冲星计时提供了一种更可行的解决方案。
